name: ChatGPT for Clinicians
desc: A free ChatGPT workspace for individual clinicians in the US.
desc_zh: 面向美国已验证个人临床医生的免费 ChatGPT 工作区。
solves: Clinicians either use a general assistant or nothing at all. This one checks who you are, cites medical literature, and keeps chart data out of public searches.
solves_zh: 临床医生过去只能在通用助手和不用之间选。这个版本先确认身份，再给出文献出处，病历不会进入公开检索。
best_for: You are a clinician checking a drug interaction or a guideline between patients.
best_for_zh: 你是临床医生，要在两个病人之间查一条药物相互作用或指南。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI news, https://openai.com/index/making-chatgpt-better-for-clinicians）。 Before the discovery window but missing from the ledger partition list, so proposed under rule (b). Individual-clinician product; the organisation-facing one is ChatGPT for Healthcare. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/making-chatgpt-better-for-clinicians
